# Test that a repository's ignore file keeps excluded pages out of the
# site, in both static output and the development server.

md2html -html out -html-ext html -nav repo/docs

exists out/index.html
exists out/guide.html

# Working notes the repository excludes are not published
! exists out/planning/roadmap.html
! exists out/bakeoff-2026.html

# The server enumerates the same tree, so it agrees
md2html -http :8099 -nav repo/docs &
wait-port :8099

curl -s http://localhost:8099/guide
stdout '<h1.*>Guide</h1>'

curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:8099/planning/roadmap
stdout '404'

# ...and an excluded page is absent from the navigation
curl -s http://localhost:8099/
! stdout 'Roadmap'

-- repo/.mintignore --
# Local working notes, not part of the site.
docs/planning/
bakeoff-*.md

-- repo/docs/index.md --
# Home

-- repo/docs/guide.md --
# Guide

-- repo/docs/planning/roadmap.md --
# Roadmap

-- repo/docs/bakeoff-2026.md --
# Bakeoff
